crossRefs.note: For because you didn’t carry it at first, Yahweh our God broke out in anger against us, because we didn’t seek him…
The children of the Levites bore God’s ark on their shoulders with its poles, as Moses commanded according to Yahweh’s…
“When Aaron and his sons have finished covering the sanctuary and all the furniture of the sanctuary, as the camp moves…
Joshua the son of Nun called the priests, and said to them, “Take up the ark of the covenant, and let seven priests…
Nadab and Abihu, the sons of Aaron, each took his censer, and put fire in it, and laid incense on it, and offered…
Fire came out from Yahweh, and devoured the two hundred fifty men who offered the incense.
He struck of the men of Beth Shemesh, because they had looked into Yahweh’s ark, he struck fifty thousand seventy of…
But when he was strong, his heart was lifted up, so that he did corruptly, and he trespassed against Yahweh his God…
For this cause many among you are weak and sickly, and not a few sleep.

parallels.note: Yahweh’s anger burned against Uzzah; and God struck him there for his error; and he died there by God’s ark.

people.name: Uzzah
people.line: Died while moving the ark; place named after him

translations.web: Yahweh’s anger burned against Uzza, and he struck him, because he put his hand on the ark; and he died there before God.
translations.bsb: And the anger of the LORD burned against Uzzah, and He struck him down because he had put his hand on the ark. So he died there before God.
translations.kjv: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against Uzza, and he smote him, because he put his hand to the ark: and there he died before God.
translations.asv: And the anger of Jehovah was kindled against Uzza, and he smote him, because he put forth his hand to the ark; and there he died before God.
